proposed_observation_states.definition: Intended receiver secures the pass within the declared ready-to-act tolerance; no material delivery-caused correction under the declared coding protocol.
Offense retains live control after reach, bobble, gather, relocation or teammate recovery; record who secures it and consequences rather than implying a clean intended catch.
No live clean catch, but offense retains an inbound/other stoppage; disruption can remain without a turnover.
Defense obtains control, even if the offense steals it back in a later distinct event.
Offense loses possession by applicable out-of-bounds/violation/event; scorer attribution stored separately.
Loose-ball or possession-control decision not yet observed at the horizon; censor/resolve explicitly, never quietly count as a clean catch.

controlled_comparisons.hold: same route, passer/receiver abilities, initial defense, flight/release context
controlled_comparisons.change: on-target versus low/high/behind/late but reachable, then beyond reachable envelope
controlled_comparisons.direction: Worse placement can first increase retained corrections, then losses; a reachable ball need not preserve the original shot. No forced monotonic loss from every tiny offset.

controlled_comparisons.change: receiving technique at fixed geometry, then geometry at fixed technique separately
controlled_comparisons.direction: Better technique should help securing/use where physically feasible; extra reach can expand access without guaranteeing clean control or finish.

controlled_comparisons.hold: same intended endpoint, receiver/handler skills and route
controlled_comparisons.change: interception access or recovery timing, one at a time
controlled_comparisons.direction: Deflection/loose-ball recovery may preserve offense. Do not count a deflection and resulting loss as two turnovers.

controlled_comparisons.factor: downstream cost conditional on retained receipt
controlled_comparisons.hold: delivered error and current receiver position/release skill
controlled_comparisons.change: remaining shot clock or defender closure opportunity separately
controlled_comparisons.direction: Record control time, extra movement, release-ready time, next action and contest at actual release; allow reset/no shot, not just an accuracy multiplier.

controlled_comparisons.hold: declared matched pressure/geometry and separate ability fields
controlled_comparisons.change: ground roll, aerial lob, perimeter drive outlet/pop strata
controlled_comparisons.direction: Keep denominators by stratum and terminal type. Different required height, velocity, timing and landing/preparation cannot be collapsed into one universal reception rate.

calibration_finding.meaning: Historical aggregate bookkeeping/budget checks only; no empirical conditional calibration for release/placement-to-catch outcomes.
